verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost identical. In both, the dark circle has grown far bigger than in the original: it now fills most of the lower half and is cut off at the bottom and right, and the can floats off-centre inside it. There is also wasted space above the quote mark, and the logo sits on its own, close to the circle's left edge. The only difference is the logo: A keeps it at a legible size, while B shrinks it to a tiny, harder-to-read mark, so A is slightly better.
